newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB May debenture coupon seen at 2.5 pct--bankers.
newsitem.headline: LTCB May debenture coupon seen at 2.5 pct--bankers.

text.p: The Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) is likely to raise the coupon rate of its May five-year bank debenture to 2.5 percent from 1.9 percent in April, sources at long-term credit banks said on Tuesday.
The bank is also likely to raise its May long-term prime lending rate by 0.6 percentage point to 3.1 percent, the sources said.
LTCB plans to announce the coupon rate for its new five-year debenture and its long-term prime rate for May at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT).

The Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd (IBJ), the largest of Japan's three long-term credit banks announced on Monday that it would raise its long-term prime lending rate for May by 0.6 percentage point to 3.1 percent.
IBJ also said it would raise the coupon rate for its May five-year debenture to 2.2 percent from 1.6 percent in April.
LTCB last raised the coupon rate of its five-year bank debentures to 1.9 percent from 1.8 percent in February.
